skill.name: customer-support
skill.description: Customer support guidance skill for designing AI-assisted support workflows, ticket routing, knowledge bases, and omnichannel customer experience processes.
skill.summary: Design AI-assisted customer support workflows, escalation plans, and self-service content.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline code around a documentation path in SKILL.md line 24. I found no executable code, external command invocation, or prompt injection text in the reviewed skill content. No semantic security findings were identified.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 24 uses backticks only to format the path resources/implementation-playbook.md in Markdown. It does not invoke Ruby, a shell, or any executable command.

content.value_statement: Support teams need consistent workflows across chat, email, tickets, and knowledge bases. This skill helps design automation, escalation, analytics, and self-service processes for better customer experiences.
actual_capabilities: Design chatbot flows with intent handling and sentiment-aware responses.
Create ticket routing, SLA escalation, and follow-up workflows.
Plan knowledge base, FAQ, and self-service troubleshooting content.
Outline omnichannel support processes for email, chat, social, and phone.
Define support metrics such as CSAT, NPS, CES, and cost per contact.
Create crisis, escalation, and surge capacity playbooks.
limitations: It provides guidance and templates, not direct integration with support platforms.
It cannot verify private customer data or live ticket history unless provided.
It does not replace legal, compliance, or security review for regulated support operations.
Platform-specific implementation details require validation in the target environment.

use_cases.title: Build Support Automation
use_cases.description: Create intake, routing, escalation, and follow-up workflows for common customer issues.

use_cases.title: Improve Self-Service Content
use_cases.description: Plan help center articles, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and search improvements.

use_cases.title: Measure Support Quality
use_cases.description: Define CSAT, NPS, CES, sentiment, and productivity metrics for support reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a common support issue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple support workflow for [issue type]. Include intake questions, response steps, escalation rules, and follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Knowledge Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a customer-facing help article for [problem]. Include symptoms, causes, resolution steps, prevention tips, and when to contact support.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Omnichannel Process
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced process design across multiple channels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an omnichannel support process for [customer segment]. Cover email, chat, social, phone, handoffs, data capture, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Support Operations
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit of a support program.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this support operation: [context]. Identify automation gaps, escalation risks, reporting needs, training priorities, and a 30-day improvement plan.

output_examples.input: Create a support workflow for delayed e-commerce orders.
output: Intake: collect order number, delivery address, carrier, promised date, and customer urgency.
Resolution: check shipment status, explain the delay, offer tracking steps, and confirm next update timing.
Escalation: route missing packages, high-value orders, and repeated delays to a senior support queue.
Follow-up: send status updates until delivery is confirmed or a replacement is approved.

output_examples.input: Improve knowledge base coverage for billing questions.
output: Map recent billing tickets into themes such as invoices, refunds, failed payments, and plan changes.
Create one article per theme with clear steps, screenshots, ownership, and review dates.
Add article feedback prompts and track deflection, search success, and reopen rates.

output_examples.input: Create support quality metrics for a growing team.
output: Track CSAT, first response time, resolution time, reopen rate, escalation rate, and customer effort score.
Review sentiment trends weekly and compare them with volume, staffing, and incident events.
Use coaching notes to connect metric changes with agent training and process updates.

best_practices: Provide customer context, channel mix, support tools, and success metrics before asking for a workflow.
Review generated support guidance with platform owners before changing live automations.
Use customer-safe examples and remove personal data from tickets before sharing context.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to make final legal, compliance, or refund policy decisions.
Do not deploy generated chatbot flows without testing edge cases and escalation paths.
Do not provide unredacted customer records when summary data is enough.

faq.question: What support channels can this skill cover?
faq.answer: It can help plan email, chat, phone, social, messaging, help center, and community support workflows.

faq.question: Can it connect directly to Zendesk or Intercom?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance that your team can adapt inside those platforms.

faq.question: Does it write customer-facing responses?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft clear replies, help articles, troubleshooting guides, and escalation messages.

faq.question: Can it analyze customer sentiment?
faq.answer: It can design sentiment review methods and response rules when you provide safe sample context.

faq.question: Is it useful for small support teams?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create lightweight workflows, templates, and metrics before a team adopts complex tools.

faq.question: What information improves the output?
faq.answer: Share the support goal, customer segment, channels, current tools, known constraints, and success metrics.
